service.description: The public projection of tasks, in the order asked. A task is answered only when its visibility is one of visibilityIds (WevGeneral when none is given: the public; a client's are WevAllUsers and WevGeneral) or its id is in vouchedIdList (an item the caller answers for whatever its visibility: the audience's own confidential item); any other is left out and counted in hiddenCount, so a caller shows it unnamed. Each item has exactly: workEffortId, rootWorkEffortId, title, state (open, closed), stateReason (completed, notPlanned, duplicate; none while open), duplicateOfWorkEffortId, statusId, closedAt, labels (labelId, name, color), milestone (milestoneId, name, dueDate, state), assigneePartyIds and, with includeLinks, linkedCommits (repositoryId, commitId, summary, date), linkedMergeRequests (repositoryId, mergeRequestId, mergeRequestNum, title, state: open, merged, closed) and linkedRefs (repositoryId, refName, refType; current ones). Never: notes and Chatter, time entries, estimates and actual time, cost and rates, allocations, a party that is no assignee, the parent and children, the purpose, priority and type, or a setting of the project.
